terms.comment: Greek βάπτισμα, a dipping; the Church’s word from the Vulgate and the Fathers on (Lewis & Short).
A parallel form; Tertullian and the Vulgate also have the neuter baptismum (Lewis & Short).

terms.gloss: the washing of baptism, the font
terms.comment: Classically a bath; Paul’s lavācrum regenerātiōnis, the washing of new birth; sacrum lavācrum in Morgan–Owens.

phrases.latin: Ūnus Dominus, ūna fidēs, ūnum baptisma.
phrases.english: One Lord, one faith, one baptism.

phrases.latin: per lavācrum regenerātiōnis et renovātiōnis Spīritūs Sānctī
phrases.english: through the washing of new birth and renewal by the Holy Spirit

sources: Lewis & Short: baptisma · Lewis & Short: baptismus · Lewis & Short: lavacrum
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. baptism.
Vulgate verses checked against the Clementine Vulgate (CrossWire VulgClementine, via the scrollmapper bible_databases repository) and Hetzenauer’s edition, in Clementine spelling.
